entries.title: Hebrews 3:1
segments: Therefore, holy brothers, called [to be] partakers of the heavenly [calling], consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, Christ Jesus,

entries.title: Hebrews 3:2
segments: who was faithful to Him who appointed Him, as Moses also [was faithful] in all his house.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:3
segments: For He was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who has built the house has more honor than the house.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:4
segments: For every house is built by someone, but He who built all things [is] God.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:5
segments: And Moses truly [was] faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken afterward.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:6
segments: But Christ [was faithful] as a Son over his own house; whose house we are, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm to the end.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:7
segments: Therefore, as the Holy Spirit says, "Today if you will hear His voice,

entries.title: Hebrews 3:8
segments: do not harden your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness,

entries.title: Hebrews 3:9
segments: when your fathers tempted Me, proved Me, and saw My works forty years.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:10
segments: Therefore I was grieved with that generation and said, They always err in [their] heart, and they have not known My ways.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:11
segments: So I swore in My wrath, They shall not enter into My rest."

entries.title: Hebrews 3:12
segments: Take heed, brothers, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from [the] living God.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:13
segments: But exhort one another daily, while it is called today, lest any of you be hardened through [the] deceitfulness of sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:14
segments: For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence steadfast to [the] end,

entries.title: Hebrews 3:15
segments: while it is said, "Today if you will hear His voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation."

entries.title: Hebrews 3:16
segments: For some, when they had heard, did provoke; however, not all who came out of Egypt by Moses.

entries.title: Hebrews 3:17
segments: But with whom was He grieved forty years? [Was it] not with those who had sinned, whose carcasses fell in the wilderness?

entries.title: Hebrews 3:18
segments: And to whom did He swear [that they should] not enter into His rest, but to those who did not believe?

entries.title: Hebrews 3:19
segments: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
